integrationBoundary.originalRetention: The service must store the original bytes separately; the adapter does not persist files.
integrationBoundary.bundle: HTML examples remain standalone files; never inline these documents into a JavaScript bundle.
integrationBoundary.security: Exact script CSP hashes, parent wrapper, service integration, and generic third-party HTML sanitization/bridge are intentionally not implemented here.
integrationBoundary.records: Real observations remain separate from explicitly simulated model records. JSON is selectable text in a dialog, not a sandbox download.
